name: Dias Vinchester
source:
I, Nefalem, could never have imagined this to be true. [url=https://vndb.org/c144568]Eva[/url] erased my memories before 10 years to avoid a surge in my power, so that I could live a normal life. But now the seal is gone. And everyone in the world will try to kill me or subjugate me. I think I need to gather a lot of allies. But most importantly, what will I bring to this world? Dark or light.

[In game description]
